title: audit detail prompt.withdraw
description: detail of audit rows with action prompt.withdraw: the author of a waiting prompt asked to take it back (ADR-083 section 3); withdrawn at once when its session has no device, else withdrawing until the device answers; the target is the prompt event. Metadata only (02-data-model.md section 2.9); every value is flat (string of printable ASCII up to 256 characters, integer, boolean or null) like the generic detail of api/org-audit.response.json.
